caption: H1: one bar. Title and machine on the left; the six views and the waiting hand centred on the page; New task, Filter, More and the coral Ask Caw on the right.
H1 at your window: the six views fold into a Board ▾ pill beside the hand, and the bar folds further to fit (fold order, below).
H2′: the same bar without the views; the six views stand alone on a bare row under it, no fill and no buttons on that row.
H2′ at your window: all six view names stay visible on their row.
Fold step 2, A: at your window the machine's name folds first (its mark and +50 stay), then New task and Filter go into More. (The same picture as H H1 at 1037.)
Fold step 2, B: at your window New task and Filter go into More first, and the machine's name stays in the bar.
D1: five 224px columns side by side, no stage strip; every stage whole on screen.
D2: the stage strip with every count over 300px columns that scroll sideways; Done is cut at the edge, Dropped past it. (The same picture as H H1 at 1440.)
D at your window: both options are this picture, the strip over 300px columns, because five columns don't fit in 809px. (The same picture as H H1 at 1037.)
P1: the stage strip over one stage's cards. Its cost: one stage at a time, so a stage with one card is one card and an empty screen.
P2: one grouped list, Ready open, the other heads pinned above the foot bar.

(ii) At your window the task opens in the board's place with Back, full width; the board and its counts wait until you go back.
